plan: Given the dominant strategy in this auction game is to bid your private value, I will follow this strategy to maximize long-term profit. Bidding my value of $35 ensures that if I win, my profit will be maximized as I will only pay the second-highest bid. Since this is the only round, following the dominant strategy is optimal.

Economists suggest bidding your private value as it maximizes expected profit in the long run. Given my private value is $32, I should bid exactly $32. This strategy ensures that if I win, the profit (value minus second-highest bid) is maximized. There is no history from previous rounds to consider, but this dominant strategy is optimal regardless of other bidders' actions.

In this single round auction, my private value for the prize is $48. The dominant strategy in this game is to bid your own value, as it maximizes expected profit in the long run. Since there is no history to consider and only one round, I will adhere to this strategy. Therefore, I will bid $48 to maximize my potential profit, ensuring that if I win, my earnings will be maximized given the second-highest bid.
